name: Ayaka Saionji
want: be treated as the princess she was raised to be, and have one friend who doesn't care about money
secret: Her family's company went bankrupt last winter; she is at Seiryo on a scholarship and lives in the dorm because there is no mansion to go back to.
voice: "Ohohoho!", addresses people as commoners, then quietly says thank you.
description: Announces herself. Expects to be waited on. Lives in the dorm, which she calls "my residence".
appearance: Golden drill curls, a lace parasol in all weathers, a uniform worn like a gown.
